providers.direct: Three directly aligned System allocations held for the entire batch; no Memory API call
providers.system: Same three persistent allocations through Memory SYSTEM
providers.arena: Same three persistent allocations through Memory ARENA with chunk 65536 and budget 67108864

layouts.full: RGB 3WH + full luma WH + complete output WH
layouts.ring: RGB 3WH + gray row ring min(H,3)W + complete output WH

comparison_order: With provider direct fixed, full versus ring is an ordinary consumer layout contrast
With one layout fixed, direct versus Memory SYSTEM versus Memory ARENA estimates interface/provider increment
Use the same persistent three-allocation batch baseline; direct steady-state provider allocations are already zero

semantic_contract.input: P6 RGB8, bounded at 8388608 pixels, file preload outside task
semantic_contract.source: Common stable preloaded vector; every frame copies the full source into the RGB workspace
semantic_contract.batch: 1 to 32 repeated images of one fixed size; controlled harness only, no production batch demand established
semantic_contract.rounding: Per pixel (77R+150G+29B)>>8, then edge-clamped sum of nine gray values /9
semantic_contract.conversion_count: Exactly WH gray conversions per completed frame
semantic_contract.output: Complete blur output retained until final-frame PGM write completes; every frame is completely checksummed
semantic_contract.lease: Each Memory writer lease covers its whole allocation; row views do not create independent lease ownership
semantic_contract.cleanup: Release each worker lease after last access, free owners, collect/drain/destroy; explicit final zero checks

functional_validation.oracle: Independent Python full-image scalar integer implementation; byte-for-byte complete PGM comparison
failures: injected worker exception after admitted RGB copy
output open failure because target is an existing directory
functional_validation.standard_finish: All six provider/layout combinations also complete a three-frame batch without early owner close
functional_validation.close_safety: Admit leases, release owners and begin close before worker data access; collect is BUSY and drain(0) is TIMEOUT, worker access remains valid; direct keeps owner until join
functional_validation.resource_oracle: Independent first-fit chunk capacity simulation with 64-byte alignment; backing and payload remain distinct

diagnostic_clock.stop: After all frame workers, complete final output write, all workspace cleanup and common source final release
diagnostic_clock.status: Diagnostic only; not low-perturbation performance samples, no timing qualification

resource_accounting.logical_payload: Sum of the three allocation requests
resource_accounting.unique_owned_backing: Direct/System requests or Memory snapshot backing; excludes external source and metadata
resource_accounting.steady_state_provider_allocations: Actual pre-cleanup provider allocation counter minus initial workspace counter; direct counts its native allocation calls using the same boundary
resource_accounting.external_source_capacity: std::vector capacity reported separately, never double counted as owned workspace backing
resource_accounting.arena_padding_and_spare: Part of backing minus live payload; not equated to RSS

qualification.mechanism: No PFN, PMU, translation aggregation, RSS or time benefit claim
